title: Tralalero Tralala
blurb: Tralalero Tralala — the three-legged shark in Nike sneakers, patriarch of the entire Italian brainrot universe. The absurd Italian voiceover launched a thousand AI-generated creatures and one of the strangest meme movements in internet history. Nobody can explain why a shark in trainers conquered global youth culture, but the audio is undeniable proof that it did.
origin: The founding character of the Italian brainrot meme wave.
